FILE_NAME: ORDERED BY WHAT IS USED/CREATED FIRST
prereq.py: Goes through undergrad course catalog to retreive all undergraduate courses at GaTech
Filters out any courses that is special topic/problem, research, internship, recitation, or lab
Creates program_courses.json file with all the courses found
program_courses.json: Lists all courses for all subjects offered at GaTech in a dictionary
Key is subject and value is array of all courses
json_to_xlsx.py: Converts the program_courses.json file to an xlsx file
program_courses.xlsx: Each tab is the subject and the first course in column 1 in each row is the main course
find_prereqs_V1.py: Uses program_courses.json file to look for all courses offered this semester
Uses selenium to navigate through Schedule of Classes to find all available links for course information pages
These pages include the co-reqs and ore-reqs
course_links.json: Similar to program_courses.json, but each course now has a link with it
parse_reqs_to_excel.py: Similar program that takes in text and parses and courses found
Will be used to get the prereqs from the course information pages
links_to_prereqs.py: Goes through course_links.json to retrieve the prereqs for each course from its course page
Creates prereqs.json file that lists all subjects, its courses, and each courses' prereqs
prereqs.json: Json file that lists all subjects, its courses, and each courses' prereqs
Each key is the subject. Each value is an array of its courses
Each course is also a key to an an array of values that are its prereqs
